packageRules.description: ESLint 10 has no compatible eslint-plugin-react / eslint-plugin-import / eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y release, and the Airbnb rule set depends on all three. Revisit once those plugins ship v10 support.
typescript-eslint throws on TypeScript >= 7 (typescript-eslint#10940). The lint toolchain pins the TypeScript 6 compiler API via @typescript/typescript6; keep it on 6.x until upstream supports 7.
